headline: Stock Market: Retreat Near 2,600 Points Amid Banking Pressure
summary: The Athens stock market fell back near 2,600 points as banking stocks came under pressure. Investors were taking advantage of a downward international climate to lock in profits.
why: The Athens benchmark index tracks Greece's main listed companies, and Greek banks are a large weight in it, so bank share moves drive its direction.
why_moved: Banking stocks came under pressure while investors locked in profits amid a downward international climate.
